programs.name: gap_adjusted_efficiency
programs.rationale: Balances reward per duration and continuously scaled contact-gap overhead against normalized conflict weight. Uses only base features, adding no graph operations; the overhead approximation can miss neighborhood overlap.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + duration + max(station_gap, satellite_gap) * degree / (1 + degree)) - 0.25 * conflict_weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

programs.name: weighted_overlap_margin
programs.rationale: Discounts raw conflict reward using pairwise minimum-weight overlap, retaining the strongest rival as a floor on estimated loss. The normalized margin uses active neighbors only; local edge enumeration can be quadratic in degree.
programs.rule: (weight - max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight - 2 * neighbor_overlap_mass / max(1, degree))) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

programs.name: greedy_neighbor_exchange
programs.rationale: Subtracts one feasible packing of active conflicts from root reward, adding a small count-scaled root bonus. Neighborhood greedy work can exceed aggregate scans, and its packing can underestimate alternative reward.

programs.name: cover_normalized_pressure
programs.rationale: Ranks root reward share against a cover-based estimate of competing neighborhood reward, with a dimensionless active-crowding penalty. Structural reach is local; cover construction may cost more than neighborhood aggregates.

programs.name: packing_disagreement_rule
programs.rationale: Uses cover-based loss when root reward exceeds the local cover; otherwise discounts optimistic greedy margins by estimator disagreement. Both active-neighborhood primitives are charged, making this a potentially expensive local candidate.
programs.rule: (weight - neighbor_cover) / (1 + weight + neighbor_cover) if weight >= neighbor_cover else (weight - neighbor_packing) / (1 + weight + neighbor_packing) - 0.3 * max(0, neighbor_cover - neighbor_packing) / (1 + neighbor_cover)

programs.name: compatible_peak_balance
programs.rationale: Balances root reward against the strongest excluded rival and rewards preserving a strong compatible contact. Reaches the residual complement through a maximum scan; set construction and scanning are still paid per candidate.
programs.rule: (weight - 0.4 * max_conflict_weight + 0.2 * compatible_peak) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight + compatible_peak) - 0.1 * degree / (1 + remaining_count)

programs.name: residual_completion_proxy
programs.rationale: Scores a feasible greedy completion after including the root, normalized by total active reward, with a small local reward-share bonus. This reaches the global compatible residual; repeated greedy computation may dominate full-solve CPU.
programs.rule: (weight + residual_packing) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight) + 0.05 * weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)
